name: Halozyme Therapeutics, Inc.
moat_justification: Contractual royalties on already-approved blockbusters (DARZALEX SC, VYVGART Hytrulo, Phesgo, Ocrevus, Opdivo, Rybrevant SC versions) with clinical/regulatory/commercial switching costs once a co-formulated SC version wins share; gross margins 76.8-84.3% over the last five fiscal years and roic_proxy above the cost of capital through the cycle (15.1-25.1%, 2021-2025; denominator distorted by convertible-funded buybacks that shrank book equity). Capped at 7 because the core ENHANZE patent expires ~2027-2029, a large share of royalties rolls off by 2035, and Alteogen's competing hyaluronidase already powers Merck's Keytruda SC.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 4.1%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 4.79 vs 3-yr median 3.28 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 5.1x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier B (18.1%) vs bull-case tier S (26.3%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: Contractual royalty toll-booth on approved blockbusters, moat 7/10 — clears 15% at $121.84 on TTM numbers (22.6% weighted IRR, IV@15% $243.61) and on the bear case, but duration past the 2027-29 ENHANZE patent cliff is the bet; clears 15% up to $243.61, not the 25% hurdle (up to $103.09).
moat_for: Contractual royalties on approved blockbusters running past the core patent date (DARZALEX SC through ~2032)
Clinical/regulatory/commercial switching costs on co-formulated SC products (~96% US conversion for DARZALEX SC)
Six material royalty contributors and broadening deal flow (five new agreements through July 2026, incl. ADCs and nucleic acids)
Near-zero-capex royalty economics (TTM capex $12.4M on TTM OCF $818.6M) with ~84% gross margin
Hypercon/SurfBio second platform with IP guided into the mid-2040s
moat_against: Single-platform concentration: ENHANZE is the business until Hypercon royalties arrive in the 2030s
Core ENHANZE patent expiry 2027-2029 weakens pricing power on new deals; royalty roll-off into 2035
Alteogen competition is live via Merck's Keytruda Qlex, with costly multi-country Mdase litigation
Partner concentration in a handful of blockbusters whose patent cycles Halozyme does not control
Acquisition appetite (Elektrofi, Surf Bio) converts a pure royalty stream into balance-sheet and integration risk
